MomToxicated: Mitis Green. Manufactured in 1814 to be a pigment in the most beautiful of emerald shades.
MomToxicated: Seeing as our dear Velimir already gave away all of the classified information. Sure. Why not.
PapaPolar: (you do realize i'm, y'know, right freakin' here, right?)
MomToxicated: It is also extremely toxic, as it contains a high quantity of arsenic.
MomToxicated: You heard the story of how we adopted her.
Go get a drink?
(And you do realize you can, y'know, go away, right?)

MomToxicated: Velimir told you how Neci wanted to join this religious fanatic cult masquerading as a mercenary outfit.
+5 Chemistry

MomToxicated: Did you know that on its own, arsenic has no taste or smell? It disappears perfectly undetectable into water, medicine...
MomToxicated: And how I said no. How he said yes. And off she went.
PapaPolar: don't gotta tell me twice 8-D
PapaPolar: i'm sure M's only gonna say nice things about me, anyway.
MomToxicated: Pizza.
MomToxicated: What he probably didn't tell you, is the fact that I had just come back from a year-long black ops intel operation investigating Scaldra.
MomToxicated: Mmhm.
MomToxicated: Did you want to talk to me about something?
MomToxicated: I didn't just have "a suspicion" about them, I had FACTS. Binders and stacks of floppy disks of FACTS.

I'd like to ask you about you and Velimir.
I'd like to hear the story of you and Rusalka from your point of view.
Nah... I'm good. [End.]
MomToxicated: They're bought and sold for by some of the biggest corporations in this world. Ones whose corruption and greed run deep.
MomToxicated: Well. What do you want to know?
+20 Chemistry
MomToxicated: We're talking "remake the world into their oligarchic dystopia" where us peasants live to serve them and rake the fields and kiss their golden feet.
How long have you two been together?
How did it fall apart between you two?

How did you two meet?

MomToxicated: If you can imagine a hell like that.
MomToxicated: Classified.
MomToxicated: Well. Velimir told you some of it. I might as well tell you the rest from my side.
MomToxicated: Classified.
MomToxicated: Classified.

Yeah. Let's say I have experience.

MomToxicated: Couldn't. Classified. And I mean *classified.* They'd want names. Dates. Photographs. Hard proof. Just telling them this was going on, wouldn't be good enough.
MomToxicated: Classified.
MomToxicated: Classified.
MomToxicated: Classified.
MomToxicated: Classified.
MomToxicated: Classified.
MomToxicated: Classified.
MomToxicated: And worse yet? If I told them who in each government structure was being bought and sold? They'd want to go put a stop to it.
MomToxicated: What else?
MomToxicated: What else?
MomToxicated: What else?
MomToxicated: What else?
MomToxicated: What else?
MomToxicated: What else?

Nothing wrong with being the hero.
You couldn't trust them?
MomToxicated: Classified.
MomToxicated: There is when it gets you killed. And look what happened to Neci. She's dead.
MomToxicated: It's not that I didn't trust them. *They* didn't trust *me.*
MomToxicated: Are you sensing a pattern?
Define "dead."
We don't know if she's dead.
MomToxicated: When you have a relationship with someone who works in... this kind of industry?
I'm getting the feeling I'd make a pretty lousy spy.
How did it fall apart between you two?
MomToxicated: Sigh.
MomToxicated: I know what she's not. She's not here. She's not safe. She's not herself.
MomToxicated: You need to trust the other person with more than your life.
+5 Chemistry
MomToxicated: Look, Drifter.
MomToxicated: You need to know that when they say "do this, and don't ask why, and don't ask details, just know everything depends on it, and I can't tell you anything more than that"?
MomToxicated: I'm getting that sense, too. You poor thing. lol.
MomToxicated: They mean it.
MomToxicated: I'll... throw you a bone. Tell you why he and I broke it off. From *my* side.
MomToxicated: The fact of the matter is, when I told Velimir and Neci - Not Scaldra. Not them. Anyone but them. Because of who is paying for them.
MomToxicated: I understood why Neci said that wasn't good enough. It wouldn't have been good enough for me at her age, either.
MomToxicated: But Velimir? That...
MomToxicated: It was a stab in the back. One... that I couldn't forgive lightly.
MomToxicated: And now knowing what it cost our little girl...
MomToxicated: I can't tell if it'd be worse if she were just dead. But her mind? Her soul? Or... worse?
I wish I could make some kind of promise about finding her. Or saving her. But I can't. And I won't.
Like I said, there's no knowing what's happened to her. Which means there's hope.
+5 Chemistry
MomToxicated: I didn't come here for hope.
MomToxicated: Good. And... that means I owe you an apology for how I've been treating you.
MomToxicated: But I do want to tell you I shouldn't have shot my mouth off at you from the start. We need to work together if we're going to find this Indifference and my Neci.
MomToxicated: You've got a soldier's head on your shoulders. And I shouldn't have dismissed that outright.
Yeah, well. Ease off the *verbal* toxic spores next time, okay?
"Apology" accepted?
Apology accepted.
Yeah, well. Ease off the *verbal* toxic spores next time, okay?
MomToxicated: Will do.
MomToxicated: Thanks.
MomToxicated: Thanks.
MomToxicated: Heh. Will do.
MomToxicated: Now, if you'll excuse me, I have to go find that useless melted snowman before he's too drunk to drag back to his bunk or he starts shouting at the TVs again.
